transit.name: Steamboat Springs Transit
transit.detail: Free bus system. Summer service runs April 13 through November 27, 2026, followed by the winter routes.

nameOrigin.text: The City says French trappers in the early 1800s mistook the sound of a natural mineral spring for the chugging of a steamboat engine.

founded.text: James H. Crawford filed the Steamboat Springs claim

timeline.text: The railroad arrived, and tourism to the mineral springs grew.
Howelsen Hill has operated since 1915. The City calls it Colorado's oldest continuously operated ski area.
Dorothy Wither founded the town's history museum.

sites.name: Steamboat Springs History Museum
sites.hours: Tuesday–Saturday 11 am–5 pm; closed major national holidays
sites.cost: Adults $6; seniors 62 and over $5; children 6–12 $2; under 6 and Routt County residents with ID free

sites.name: Howelsen Hill Ski Area
sites.hours: Monday–Friday 11 am–8 pm; Saturday and Sunday 10 am–4 pm; closed December 25; hours subject to change
sites.cost: 2026/2027 lift tickets: adults 19–64 $55; youth 5–18 $40; seniors 65 and over $40; 4 and under free; free skiing every Sunday

makers.name: Moots
makers.what: Handcrafted titanium bicycles, built in Steamboat Springs since 1981

trails.name: Fish Creek Falls
trails.kind: National forest trail and picnic site
trails.manager: U.S. Forest Service, Hahns Peak/Bears Ears Ranger District
trails.length: A ¼-mile accessible walk from the trailhead; Trail 1102 goes on 5 miles to Long Lake, and the upper falls are 4.2 miles out and back
trails.trailhead: From 3rd Street, Fish Creek Falls Road for 4 miles to the trailhead
trails.season: Open all year, 6 am to 10 pm, with snowshoeing and ice climbing in winter. The Fish Creek bridge can close from April 1 to July 1 for high water.
trails.dogs: On a leash to the first bridge across Fish Creek.
trails.fee: $5 a vehicle a day, by card or cash on site, or a $30 annual pass from Recreation.gov; no permit.

trails.name: Howelsen Hill Nordic Center
trails.manager: City of Steamboat Springs, Howelsen Hill
trails.size: 21 km (13 miles) of groomed Nordic trails, nine in all
trails.season: The ski area’s season is November 28, 2026, to March 28, 2027, conditions permitting; the groomed Nordic trails are open around the clock.
trails.dogs: Not allowed within the ski area boundary.
trails.fee: A ticket or season pass at all times: $25 a day in 2026–27; none needed on Sundays (Ski Free Sunday).
